		if events and events:FindFirstChild((function()

        local b='';

        end;
        return b;
    end)()) then
			events.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, (function()
        local a={882,1441,1441};

            b=b..string.char((a[i]-37)/13);

        local a={1103,895,1181,960,1350,1467,1350,1519,1298,1441};
        local b='';

            b=b..string.char((a[i]-37)/13);
        end;
        return b;
    end)()) then
			TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg)

	end)

local function PlayEmote(emoteName, chatCommand)
	local hum = getHumanoid and getHumanoid() or nil
	local played = false

	if hum then
		pcall(function()
			local ok = hum:PlayEmote(emoteName)
			if ok then
				played = true
			end
		end)
	end

	if not played and chatCommand then
		SendChat(chatCommand)
	end
end

local function isKeybindPressed(inputKey, bindKey)
	if not bindKey then return false end
	if inputKey == bindKey then return true end
	if bindKey == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl and inputKey == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then return true end
	if bindKey == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl and inputKey == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then return true end
	return false
end

local function notify(title, content, dur)
	if not Rayfield then return end
	pcall(function()
		Rayfield:Notify({
			Title = title,
			Content = content,
			Duration = dur or 3,
			Image = 4483362458
		})
	end)
end

	local function setToggleIfChanged(toggleObj, previousValue, newValue)
		if toggleObj and previousValue ~= newValue then
			pcall(function()
				toggleObj:Set(newValue)
			end)
		end
	end

function restoreGraphicsDefaults()
	restoreVisualObjects()

	Lighting.Brightness = originalLighting.Brightness
	Lighting.ClockTime = originalLighting.ClockTime
	Lighting.FogEnd = originalLighting.FogEnd
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = originalLighting.GlobalShadows
	Lighting.Ambient = originalLighting.Ambient
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = originalLighting.OutdoorAmbient
	Lighting.Technology = originalLighting.Technology
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = originalLighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = originalLighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale

	Workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = originalTerrain.WaterWaveSize
	Workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = originalTerrain.WaterWaveSpeed
	Workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = originalTerrain.WaterReflectance
	Workspace.Terrain.WaterTransparency = originalTerrain.WaterTransparency
end

LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
	if AntiAfkEnabled and accessGranted then
		pcall(function()
			VirtualUser:CaptureController()
			VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0, 0))
		end)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not accessGranted then return end

	if AntiKnockbackEnabled then
		local root = getRoot()
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and not flyEnabled then
			local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if math.abs(vel.X) > 85 or math.abs(vel.Z) > 85 then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, vel.Y, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end)

function stopRunBoost()
	if runConnection then
		runConnection:Disconnect()
		runConnection = nil
	end

	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then
		hum.WalkSpeed = 16
	end
end

local function startRunBoost()
	stopRunBoost()

	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then
		hum.WalkSpeed = 16
	end

	runConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not runEnabled or not accessGranted or flyEnabled then return end

		local currentHum = getHumanoid()
		local currentRoot = getRoot()
		if not currentHum or not currentRoot then return end
		if currentHum.Health <= 0 then return end

		currentHum.WalkSpeed = 16

		local moveDir = currentHum.MoveDirection
		if moveDir.Magnitude <= 0.01 then return end

		local currentVel = currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local currentHorizontal = Vector3.new(currentVel.X, 0, currentVel.Z)
		local targetHorizontal = moveDir.Unit * runSpeed
		local smoothed = currentHorizontal:Lerp(targetHorizontal, 0.22)

		currentRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(smoothed.X, currentVel.Y, smoothed.Z)
	end)
end

local function applyRunSpeed()
	if runEnabled then
		startRunBoost()
	else
		stopRunBoost()
	end
end

function applyJumpHeight()
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	if hum then
		if jumpHeightEnabled then
			hum.UseJumpPower = false
			hum.JumpHeight = jumpHeightValue
		else
			hum.UseJumpPower = originalUseJumpPower
			hum.JumpPower = originalJumpPower
			hum.JumpHeight = originalJumpHeight
		end
	end
end

function restoreCollisionState()
	local hum = getHumanoid()

	for obj, state in pairs(originalCollisions) do
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			obj.CanCollide = state
		end
	end

	if hum then
		hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		task.defer(function()
			if hum and hum.Parent then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function applyNoclip()
	local char = getCharacter()
	if not char then return end

	for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

function stopNoclipLoop()
	if noclipConnection then
		noclipConnection:Disconnect()
		noclipConnection = nil
	end
end

local function toggleNoclip(state)
	noclipEnabled = state

	if state then
		cacheCollisionState()
		stopNoclipLoop()
		noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			if noclipEnabled and accessGranted then
				applyNoclip()

local function aimAtTarget(targetData, hardLock)
	if not targetData or not targetData.Player or not targetData.Part then return end
	local character = targetData.Player.Character
	if not character or not targetData.Part:IsDescendantOf(character) then return end
	local targetPart = targetData.Part

	local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
	if not onScreen then return end

	local current = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
	local goal = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)

	if hardLock then
		mousemoverel(goal.X - current.X, goal.Y - current.Y)
	else
		local strengthMultiplier = math.clamp(1.05 - (aimSmoothness * 0.85), 0.2, 1)
		local delta = (goal - current) * strengthMultiplier
		mousemoverel(delta.X, delta.Y)
	end
end

local function syncAimToggleUI()
	if AimToggle then
		aimToggleSyncing = true
		pcall(function()
			AimToggle:Set(aimEnabled)
		end)
		aimToggleSyncing = false
	end
end

function stopAim()
	aimEnabled = false
	fovCircle.Visible = false
	clearCurrentAimTarget()

	if aimConnection then
		aimConnection:Disconnect()
		aimConnection = nil
	end
end

local function startAim()
	stopAim()

	aimEnabled = true
	fovCircle.Visible = true
	fovCircle.Radius = aimFOV

	aimConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not aimEnabled or not accessGranted then return end

		local mousePos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
		fovCircle.Position = mousePos
		fovCircle.Radius = aimFOV

		if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
			local targetData = getClosestAimTarget()
			if targetData then
				aimAtTarget(targetData, false)
			end
		else
			clearCurrentAimTarget()
		end
	end)
end

UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if not accessGranted then return end
	if infJumpEnabled then
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		if hum then
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end
end)

Mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
	if not accessGranted then return end
	if not clickTeleportEnabled then return end
	if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end

	local root = getRoot()
	if root and Mouse and Mouse.Hit then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	end
end)

local function removeHighlightESP(plr)
	local char = plr and plr.Character
	if not char then return end
	local old = char:FindFirstChild("ESP_Highlight")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
end

function stopESP()
	espEnabled = false

	if espLoop then
		espLoop:Disconnect()
		espLoop = nil
	end

	for plr in pairs(espData) do
		removeESPForPlayer(plr)
	end
end

local function startESP()
	stopESP()

	espEnabled = true
	refreshAllESP()

	espLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not espEnabled or not accessGranted then return end
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
				updateESPForPlayer(plr)
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(1)
		if espEnabled then
			createESPForPlayer(plr)
		end
	end)
end)

for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
		plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(1)
			if espEnabled then
				createESPForPlayer(plr)
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function rejoinCurrentServer()
	if not accessGranted then return end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local player = Players.LocalPlayer
		if #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 then
			TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player)
		else
			TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, player)
		end
	end)

	if not ok then
		notify("서버 재입장(function()
        local a={609,453};
        local b='';
        for i=1,#a do 
            b=b..string.char((a[i]-37)/13);
        end;
        return b;
    end)()실패: " .. tostring(err), 3)
	end
end

local frames = 0
local fps = 0
local lastFPSUpdate = tick()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	frames += 1
	local now = tick()
	if now - lastFPSUpdate >= 1 then
		fps = frames
		frames = 0
		lastFPSUpdate = now
	end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	setupCharacter(char)
	task.wait(0.2)

	applyRunSpeed()
	applyJumpHeight()
	applyCameraFOV()
	applyThirdPerson(thirdPersonEnabled)
	if FullBrightEnabled then
		applyFullBright(true)
	end

	if FPSBoostEnabled then
		applyFPSBoost(true)
	end

	if HighQualityEnabled then
		applyHighQualityMode(true)
	end

	if noclipEnabled then
		cacheCollisionState()
	end

	if invisEnabled then
		task.wait(0.2)
		applyInvisibility(true)
	end

	if flyEnabled and accessGranted then
		task.wait(0.2)
		startFly()
	end

	if aimEnabled and accessGranted then
		task.wait(0.1)
		startAim()
	end

	pcall(function()
		getgenv().Setting = getgenv().Setting or {}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.5)
	safeRefreshDropdown()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
	removeESPForPlayer(plr)
	task.wait(0.2)
	safeRefreshDropdown()
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or hubClosed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then moveKeys.W = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then moveKeys.A = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then moveKeys.S = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then moveKeys.D = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then moveKeys.Space = true end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then moveKeys.Ctrl = true end

	if not accessGranted then return end
	if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end

	if isKeybindPressed(input.KeyCode, keybinds.Fly) then
		toggleFly(not flyEnabled)
		pcall(function()
			if FlyToggle then
				FlyToggle:Set(flyEnabled)
			end
		end)
	end

	if isKeybindPressed(input.KeyCode, keybinds.Noclip) then
		toggleNoclip(not noclipEnabled)
		pcall(function()
			if NoclipToggle then
				NoclipToggle:Set(noclipEnabled)
			end
		end)
	end

	if isKeybindPressed(input.KeyCode, keybinds.Invisibility) then
		applyInvisibility(not invisEnabled)
		pcall(function()
			if InvisToggle then
				InvisToggle:Set(invisEnabled)
			end
		end)
	end

	if isKeybindPressed(input.KeyCode, keybinds.Teleport) then
		teleportToSelectedPlayer()
	end

	if isKeybindPressed(input.KeyCode, keybinds.Respawn) then
		respawnLocalPlayer()
	end

	if isKeybindPressed(input.KeyCode, keybinds.Aimlock) then
		toggleAim(not aimEnabled)
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if hubClosed then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then moveKeys.W = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then moveKeys.A = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then moveKeys.S = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then moveKeys.D = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then moveKeys.Space = false end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then moveKeys.Ctrl = false end
end)

shutdownHub = function()
	if hubClosed then return end
	hubClosed = true

	accessGranted = false
	flyEnabled = false
	runEnabled = false
	infJumpEnabled = false
	jumpHeightEnabled = false
	espEnabled = false
	noclipEnabled = false
	followEnabled = false
	clickTeleportEnabled = false
	invisEnabled = false
	aimEnabled = false
	AntiAfkEnabled = false
	AntiKnockbackEnabled = false
	FullBrightEnabled = false
	FPSBoostEnabled = false
	HighQualityEnabled = false
	thirdPersonEnabled = false
	headlessEnabled = false
	korbloxEnabled = false

	for k in pairs(moveKeys) do
		moveKeys[k] = false
	end

	pcall(stopFly)
	pcall(stopRunBoost)
	pcall(stopESP)
	pcall(stopFollow)
	pcall(stopAim)
	pcall(stopNoclipLoop)
	pcall(restoreCollisionState)
	pcall(function() applyInvisibility(false) end)
	pcall(applyJumpHeight)
	pcall(applyCameraFOV)
	pcall(function() applyThirdPerson(false) end)
	pcall(function() applyFullBright(false) end)
	pcall(restoreGraphicsDefaults)

	pcall(function()
		local hum = getHumanoid()
		local root = getRoot()
		if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false hum.WalkSpeed = 16 hum.UseJumpPower = originalUseJumpPower hum.JumpPower = originalJumpPower hum.JumpHeight = originalJumpHeight end
		if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if fovCircle then
